internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:09 UTC, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds. Initial diagnosis confirmed the latency issue and identified high CPU utilization (0.98) as a potential contributing factor. Error rates remained low, ruling out error injection as a cause. 

At 12:28 UTC, the flag controlling CPU resource limits was disabled to alleviate resource exhaustion. This action was approved and executed promptly. Subsequent monitoring confirmed recovery with latency dropping to 0.12 seconds. The incident was resolved without further impact.

Key actions taken:
- Disabled CPU resource limit flag for ad service
- Verified latency recovery through monitoring

This incident highlights the importance of monitoring CPU utilization as a leading indicator for latency issues in the ad service.

external.body: Between 12:09 and 12:28 UTC on 2026-11-08, customers experienced increased latency in the ad service. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting resource settings, resulting in restored service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
